activity.notes: Parakramabahu I, commonly known as Parakramabahu the Great, ruled from Polonnaruwa from 1153 to 1186. His reign unified the island under his authority and is associated with major irrigation, urban, religious and military projects. The record represents his sovereign reign at year granularity.

sources.title: Polonnaruwa — Central Cultural Fund, Sri Lanka
sources.citation_text: Sri Lanka's Central Cultural Fund identifies Parakramabahu the Great as a ruler of the Polonnaruwa kingdom and dates his reign to 1153-1186 CE.

sources.title: High-Level Meeting on Protection of the Global Climate for Present and Future Generations of Humankind — Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Sri Lanka
sources.citation_text: Sri Lanka's Ministry of Foreign Affairs identifies Parakramabahu I as one of ancient Sri Lanka's greatest kings and states that he ruled from 1153 to 1186.
